eyebrow: Cross-Platform Relational Database Administration · Chapter Seven
subtitle: Lesson 35 · MySQL Architecture & Installation

code:
sudo apt update
sudo apt install mysql-server
sudo systemctl enable --now mysql
sudo systemctl status mysql
caption: Registers a systemd service; check for a temporary root password in the install log.

code:
docker run --name mysql-dev \
  -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=changeme \
  -p 3306:3306 \
  -v mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql \
  -d mysql:8.0
caption: The named volume is what keeps data alive when the container is removed and recreated.
